description: Slice #4 COMPOSED FLAT-PATTERN SHEET golden for the authored L-bracket (base flange + ONE edge flange). The same feature tree the l-bracket-flat-pattern-view golden evaluates is now COMPOSED onto a sheet (docs/design/drawing-export.md §4.2 place_sheet + docs/design/sheet-metal.md §7): geometry evaluates the part once, unfolds the sheet-metal body, and the additive flat-pattern branch of place_sheet places the single flat blank CENTRED on the sheet (reusing the SAME extent-driven view_to_svg_edges/view_bounds machinery every standard view uses) plus a quiet-corner bend-table annotation block. Proves the composed flat-pattern ComposedSheet the frontend renders (placed view + bend-table rows + anchor rect + preserved edge_role) is byte-deterministic, and that the flat blank is centred with its bend table clear of the blank.
derivation: The flat pattern is a rectangle: 4 body edges (edge_role='body') plus one fold line per bend (edge_role='bend'). For the N=1 L-bracket: body_edge_count = 4, bend_edge_count = 1. The compose transform (view_to_svg_edges) carries edge_role THROUGH placement, so the composed edge list preserves body/bend exactly (the flat-pattern-view golden's role counts survive composition).

Layout: A4 landscape (297x210 mm), one flat_pattern view placement, title 'L-Bracket Flat Pattern', scale 1:1. The blank is placed CENTRED on the sheet (anchor = sheet centre 148.5, 105.0), so its projected-extent bbox centre coincides with the sheet centre. The bend-table block is anchored at the top-left margin corner (10, 10) — a quiet corner clear of the centred blank (asserted non-overlapping the blank bbox).

The bend_table on the ComposedSheet carries one BendTableRow per bend (positional correlation to the edge_role='bend' edges, §6): bend-1, 90 deg, radius 3 mm, up, BA 6.094689747964199 mm — the analytic nominals hand-derived in ../l-bracket-edge-flange/expected.json.

content_hash is the sha256 of the composed ComposedSheet.model_dump_json() (place_sheet output, scale 1:1, the fixed layout above). It is a DETERMINISM PIN reproducible in-process AND across a fresh interpreter restart (§9 #4) — composition is a pure function of the deterministic evaluate output. Version-pinned like the unfold golden: the arc-fit inner radius is OCCT/build123d-version-specific FP, so a kernel bump regenerates this hash; a change WITHOUT a kernel bump is a determinism regression (P0), never a retry.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set. Placement coordinates are exact rational sheet-mm; centring residual (blank bbox centre vs sheet centre) is floating-point only (<1e-12). The bend-table row values are the exact unfold outputs (measured deviation vs the analytic nominals ~1.2e-13, matching ../l-bracket-edge-flange/expected.json). The 1e-9 ceiling gives ~3 orders of headroom while staying tighter than the standing kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m).
title: L-Bracket Flat Pattern
